evidence.observation: Pressure 2.99 Torr at growth onset, consistent with prior stages (~2.96-3.0)
Monotonic pressure rise 2.99→3.01→3.11→3.20→3.28 Torr over growth while Ar flow held at ~100 sccm
Ar flow steady ~99-101 sccm, so rise is not a flow increase
Temperature stable at setpoint 750 °C, heater power nominal; rise not thermally driven
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere integrity cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 (or leak-check) reading would separate an air in-leak from an exhaust restriction; alternatively a brief Ar flow step/pump-down test to see whether pressure tracks flow (blockage) or holds/climbs independently (leak).
